summary: Short, very steep kerb on a junction slip lane beside a main road.
reasons: Slip lane at busy junction, no parking

best_section.where: West kerb of the curved slip lane off Montrose Road

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks and a car park lie behind the kerb; the junction is open on all sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow curved kerb with no cars parked; stopping would sit in or at the edge of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Beside a main arterial junction with constant traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars; 2P sign, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 17% grade, above the 12% limit
Main road junction, no kerb parking
sun_shade: Trees on the west side shade the morning; open to afternoon sun.
